task_description: Write a method in Dafny to convert an array to a sequence.
specification_response:

    method ArrayToSequence(a: array<int>) returns (seqResult: seq<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned sequence seqResult is equal to the sequence of elements in the input array a in order
- The length of seqResult equals the length of the array a
code_response:

In this case:
    method ArrayToSequence(a: array<int>) returns (seqResult: seq<int>)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.

Dafny specification:

    - The length of the sequence is equal to the length of the array
    
Dafny specification:

    ensures |seqResult| == a.Length
